incident-bot: ALERT: service=redwood-serving cluster=us-west-2 error_rate=6.2% span=5m. Symptoms: container restarts, CUDA OOMs, mlx5 timeout logs, high RDMA retransmit. PagerDuty: P12345 triggered for mira (oncall).

pagerduty: Paging mira: schedule escalated to eng-sre.

mira (oncall): acked. I'm on it, pulling logs now. Can someone confirm customer impact?

alex (cs): multiple users reporting 500s since ~06:12 UTC, support tickets opened (INC-2491, INC-2492). Confirming at least 3 paying customers affected.

jordan (eng-sre): jump in. Any recent deploys? deploy-bot, were there rollouts in us-west-2?

deploy-bot: No automated deploys in the last 30m. Canary on redwood-l13 paused.

samir (runtime): I'm seeing a pattern: pods on node n-uw2-gpu-07 show repeated `Cuda out of memory` followed by process kill and then `mlx5_core: completion timeout` in dmesg. Suspect IB/RDMA packet loss causing kernel-level timeouts that bubble up to serving runtime -> KV cache fragmentation -> OOMs.

lucy (infra): running `ibstat` + `ethtool` now. Also starting netprobe across rack.

mira (oncall): copy. Quick mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic away from n-uw2-gpu-07 2) cordon + drain 3) enable routing fallback to cpu-quantized variant for critical customers 4) collect diagnostics for postmortem.

jordan (eng-sre): I'll take step 1/2. Mira hand over?

mira (oncall): handing to jordan in 1m, I need to notify CS and keep watch on impact.

jordan (eng-sre): running: `kubectl get pods -o wide -n serving | grep n-uw2-gpu-07`

# snippet pasted by jordan (eng-sre)
jordan (eng-sre): ```
NAME                                   READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
serve-redwood-l13-5ff7d8b7c-2x9kq     1/1     Running   12         3d    n-uw2-gpu-07
serve-redwood-l13-5ff7d8b7c-pz3hl     1/1     Running   0          2h    n-uw2-gpu-14
```

jordan (eng-sre): cordoning n-uw2-gpu-07 now: `kubectl cordon n-uw2-gpu-07` -> Drain in progress, deleting pods to move to healthy nodes.

samir (runtime): while drain runs, add temporary routing override: `route-policy set region=us-west-2 model=redwood-l13 fallback=model-l13-quant-v1` for customers with severity=high. That reduces memory pressure.

mira (oncall): done notif to CS: "We are routing traffic away from an unhealthy GPU node in us-west-2 and enabling a fallback model for critical customers. We expect degraded latency but restored availability within ~10-15m." :thumbsup:

alex (cs): acknowledged, passing to customers.

lucy (infra): netprobe output from the rack: `loss=7.8% pkts retransmitted, ib_dev mlx5_0 reports CQ error -> qp timeout`. Also seeing NIC counters increment rx_errors.

samir (runtime): saving a representative OOM/kern log for diagnostics:

# log block
samir (runtime): ```
[  182.345678] mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: mlx5_cmd: fw assert
[  182.346001] mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0:completion timeout
[  182.346212] device mlx5_0: completion timeout, recovery might be needed
[  182.347000] ServingRuntime[pid=21544]: CUDA error: out of memory while allocating 2048MiB
[  182.347223] ServingRuntime[pid=21544]: killing container, exit code 137
```

lucy (infra): I'm opening a ticket with cloud provider NIC team and isolating the HC node. For now marking node as `degraded` in inventory.

jordan (eng-sre): drains finished. Traffic redistributed. Watching error rate.

mira (oncall): current error rate dropped from 6.2% -> 2.1% but still above baseline 0.5%. Some tails remain.

# quick mitigation adjustments
samir (runtime): additionally: 1) turn off KV prefix caching on affected model instances to avoid big GPU allocations from cache rebuild storms: `SETENV REDWOOD_KVCACHE_ENABLED=false` via rollout config. 2) set max_batch_tokens=512 to reduce burst memory. Rolling these now to a small canary first.

jordan (eng-sre): canary patch applied to 10% of instances in us-west-2. Monitoring.

lucy (infra): NIC error counters continue to tick but less correlated to user-facing pods now. We might still see intermittent packet reorders causing RDMA timeouts; working with provider on hardware-level reset window.

# customer impact update
alex (cs): customers with IDs C-1004 and C-1012 reported transient 500s; both saw <5 minutes of failures. They are happy with the quick mitigation note but asked for RCA once done.

mira (oncall): good. I'll create interim incident update for status page with ETA.

# oncall handoff
mira (oncall): handing off to jordan for night watch and RCA lead. I'll remain available for CS comms. Jordan please take incident to stable state and file postmortem.

jordan (eng-sre): taking over. Assigning ownership: eng-runtime (samir) for root cause + fix, infra (lucy) for hardware/firmware follow-up, eng-sre (jordan) for runbook updates + rollout safeguards.

# actions tracked
jordan (eng-sre): ACTIONS: [1] postmortem ticket INC-2251 created. [2] runbook update: add `mlx5` netprobe step + kube drain checklist. [3] add automatic routing fallback on NIC errors >5%.

samir (runtime): also adding a short-term mitigation flag in config to auto-disable kvcache for nodes with >3 NIC errors in 10m.

lucy (infra): provider scheduled a firmware reload on the ToR NICs in the rack during a maintenance window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. May require brief drain window.

alex (cs): I'll send customers the post-incident note and let them know devs are on RCA.

mira (oncall): error rate stabilized at 0.6% baseline. Closing active pager. If anything resurfaces, re-open PD. Great teamwork :clap:.

# final notes
jordan (eng-sre): Leaving trace collection: `kubectl logs --since=1h -n serving > /tmp/serve-usw2-225123.log` and uploaded to S3 `s3://redwood-incident-logs/2251234567/`.

samir (runtime): posting quick reproduction notes in the postmortem: packet reordering -> RDMA timeouts -> completion timeouts -> mlx5 core recovery path triggers kernel stall -> serving runtime sees KV cache growth and OOMs -> container restarts. Root fix options: NIC firmware + driver patches, improve runtime backpressure on cache rebuild, add routing fallback thresholds.

jordan (eng-sre): assigning tasks in INC-2251 and closing this thread.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: incident=INC-2251 state=stabilized closed_by=jordan time=2251234620
